items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The mention of 'Savoy' is part of the interviewer's narrative about where 'he' (Chick Webb) and others were playing; the interviewee does not speak about a personal relationship with Savoy.

ctx.x: That was back in '35, around '35, '36, before the War, before the Second World War. That's when we had the Lafayette Theatre. Every Sunday a whole gang of us would go to the Lafayette Theatre and then we'd leave there and go to Savoy because that's where he and all the gang were playing. They had two bands there every Sunday night.
Every Sunday night would it be a different band?
